user.title: Set up Roller Shutter Suite
user.description: Do you want to set up Roller Shutter Suite? The next pages ask for the values of the house. Groups and windows inherit them unless they set their own.

features.title: Features
features.description: Choose what is switched on. Only the features that are switched on get a page of their own.

data_description.schedule_enabled: Opens the shutters in the morning and closes them in the evening. While it is switched off, the daily routine moves nothing; protection keeps running.

feature_daily_routine_general.title: Daily routine
feature_daily_routine_general.description: How far the shutters open and close, how workdays, weekends and public holidays are told apart, and what else can begin the evening. The times follow on the next pages, one page per kind of day.

data_description.schedule_morning_position: Where the shutter goes in the morning. 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. The morning only raises: a shutter that is already higher stays where it is.
data_description.schedule_evening_position: Where the shutter goes in the evening. 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. The evening only lowers: a shutter that is already lower stays where it is.
data_description.schedule_workday_source_choice: An entity that is on on workdays, for example the workday sensor of Home Assistant. With "None", Monday to Friday are workdays.
data_description.schedule_holiday_source_choice: An entity that is on on public holidays; a calendar with an all-day event works too. With "None" there are no public holidays.
data_description.schedule_season_source_choice: An entity that is on while it is summer. While it has no value, its last known value counts.
data_description.schedule_summer_by_date: Without a summer entity, summer lasts from the first to the last day given below.
data_description.schedule_summer_first_day: Month and day with two digits each, for example 05-01 for 1 May.
data_description.schedule_summer_last_day: Month and day with two digits each, for example 09-30 for 30 September. The range may run across the turn of the year.
data_description.schedule_evening_position_summer: Replaces the evening position while it is summer, for example 30 % for privacy with some air. It counts only with a summer entity or with summer by date.
data_description.schedule_brightness_source_choice: An entity that reports the outdoor brightness in lux. When it has been darker than the threshold for the delay, the evening begins early, but never before "not before" of the evening. An entity without a value begins nothing and blocks nothing.
data_description.schedule_brightness_threshold_lux: Below this outdoor brightness, in lux, it counts as dark.

expert.name: Expert values
expert.description: Sensible defaults apply. Change them only if you know why.

data_description.schedule_brightness_delay: For how many minutes it has to be dark before the evening begins.
data_description.schedule_random_offset: Moves every trigger by up to this many minutes, earlier or later, differently for each window and day. 0 switches it off; 30 is the maximum.

feature_daily_routine_workday.title: Daily routine on workdays
feature_daily_routine_workday.description: When the morning and the evening begin on a workday.

data_description.schedule_workday_morning_kind: A fixed time; sunrise in the morning or sunset in the evening, with an offset; or the elevation of the sun. For the two that follow the sun, "not before" and "not after" under the expert values limit the time.
data_description.schedule_workday_evening_kind: A fixed time; sunrise in the morning or sunset in the evening, with an offset; or the elevation of the sun. For the two that follow the sun, "not before" and "not after" under the expert values limit the time.

expert.name: Expert values

basics.title: Window
basics.description: Choose the cover of this window. If several covers are always moved together, choose all of them or a cover group.

data_description.covers: A cover can belong to one window only.
data_description.group_id: The window inherits its values from this group. Leave empty to inherit from the house directly.

members.title: Members of the cover group
members.description:
{groups} is a cover group. A group reports only the mean of its members, so the window stores and moves the members themselves:

{members}

degraded.title: Cover without positions
degraded.description:
These covers cannot be driven to a position, or do not report one: {covers}

They are accepted and are only opened and closed. For them shading positions, other positions in between and the detection of manual operation are inactive.

options.inherit_reference: Inherit (at present: the entity named below)

window_covers_unreadable.title: Window "{window}" is not set up
window_covers_unreadable.description: The stored covers of the window "{window}" cannot be read, so the window is not set up and nothing acts on it. Every other window runs as usual. To repair this, open the window, choose its covers again and save it, or remove the window.

group_missing.title: The group of window "{window}" no longer exists
group_missing.description: The window "{window}" refers to a group that was removed. It inherits its values from the house until you open the window and save it, with another group or without one.

group_reference_unreadable.title: The group of window "{window}" cannot be read
group_reference_unreadable.description: The stored reference from the window "{window}" to its group cannot be read. Protection keeps running with the values of the house. The comfort functions of this window pause, because it is not known which values the group would have set. To repair this, open the window, choose its group again and save it.

dry_run_unreadable.title: Dry-run of window "{window}" cannot be read
dry_run_unreadable.description: The stored dry-run state of the window "{window}" cannot be read. The window is treated as being in dry-run, so it does not move. To repair this, open the window and save it.

option_unavailable.title: Window "{window}" cannot use the setting "{key}"
option_unavailable.description: The window "{window}" sets "{key}" itself, but these covers cannot do what the setting needs: {covers}. The value stays stored and applies again as soon as the covers can do it.

setting_combination.title: Stored settings do not fit together
setting_combination.description: Each of these stored values alone is fine, but together they are not permitted: {settings}. The name in brackets says where each value is stored. Comfort functions that depend on them pause for the windows concerned; protection keeps running. To repair this, change one of the values and save.

rule_without_keys.title: Stored settings were refused without a reason that can be named
rule_without_keys.description: The settings of at least one window were refused as a whole, and the integration could not tell which values are concerned. This is an error in the integration, not in your data. Protection keeps running; comfort functions pause. Please report it to the author of the integration.

setting_fault_global_unreadable.title: A stored setting cannot be used: the house
setting_fault_global_unreadable.description: The stored value of the setting "{key}" cannot be read. Functions that protect people or hardware or that restrict movement keep running with the value of the next level. Comfort functions that depend on a faulty value pause for the windows concerned, so that no shutter moves unexpectedly. To repair this, open the integration, choose "Reconfigure" and save the values of the house.

setting_fault_global_none_not_allowed.title: A stored setting cannot be used: the house
setting_fault_global_none_not_allowed.description: The setting "{key}" is stored as "none", but it always needs a value. Functions that protect people or hardware or that restrict movement keep running with the value of the next level. Comfort functions that depend on a faulty value pause for the windows concerned, so that no shutter moves unexpectedly. To repair this, open the integration, choose "Reconfigure" and save the values of the house.
